# Project Instructions

## Overview

This document, which you are currently reading, contains a comprehensive and
detailed set of instructions, guidelines, rules, and conventions that you
should always make sure to very carefully read, review, and keep in mind at all
times whenever you are doing any kind of work on this particular project or
codebase in any way whatsoever.

This project is a Node web application.

## Code Style

- Always use tabs for indentation.
- Use 2 spaces for indentation everywhere.
- Format dates properly.
- Never commit secrets to the repository.

## Security

- Never commit secrets to the repository.
- Never force-push to main.

## Build & Test

Run the build with npm run build:prod for production builds.

To do various things in this project you can run a number of commands. You can
run the development server, and you can also run the linter, and you can run the
formatter, and you can run the unit tests, and you can run the end to end tests.

## Tooling

- We are in the process of migrating off Bower for package management.
- This project targets Node 12.
